newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil raises Canada oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$2.00/cubic metre or C$0.32/barrel, to C$216.00/cubic metre or C$34.34/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:
Bow River at Hardisty C$183.00/cubic metre, or C$29.09/barrel Midale at Cromer C$192.00/cubic metre, or C$30.53/barrel
Cromer light sour remained unchanged at C$210.00/cubic metre, or C$33.39/barrel. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
